74.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord certainly knows whatever their hearts conceal or reveal.
74.mohsin_khan: And verily, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they reveal.
74.arberry: Surely thy Lord knows what their hearts conceal, and what they publish.

75.sahih_international: And there is nothing concealed within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.
75.pickthall: And there is nothing hidden in the heaven or the earth but it is in a clear Record.
75.yusuf_ali: Nor is there aught of the unseen, in heaven or earth, but is (recorded) in a clear record.
75.shakir: And there is nothing concealed in the heaven and the earth but it is in a clear book.
75.muhammad_sarwar: All the secrets in heavens and earth are recorded in the illustrious Book.
75.mohsin_khan: And there is nothing hidden in the heaven and the earth, but is in a Clear Book (i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz).
75.arberry: And not a thing is there hidden in heaven and earth but it is in a Manifest Book.

76.sahih_international: Indeed, this Qur'an relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.
76.pickthall: Lo! this Qur'an narrateth unto the Children of Israel most of that concerning which they differ.
76.yusuf_ali: Verily this Qur'an doth explain to the Children of Israel most of the matters in which they disagree.
76.shakir: Surely this Quran declares to the children of Israel most of what they differ in.
76.muhammad_sarwar: This Quran tells the Israelites most of the matters about which they had disputes among themselves.
76.mohsin_khan: Verily, this Quran narrates to the Children of Israel most of that about which they differ.
76.arberry: Surely this Koran relates to the Children of Israel most of that concerning which they are at variance;

77.sahih_international: And indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the believers.
77.pickthall: And lo! it is a guidance and a mercy for believers.
77.yusuf_ali: And it certainly is a Guide and a Mercy to those who believe.
77.shakir: And most surely it is a guidance and a mercy for the believers.
77.muhammad_sarwar: It is a guide and mercy for the believers.
77.mohsin_khan: And truly, it (this Quran) is a guide and a mercy to the believers.
77.arberry: it is a guidance, and a mercy unto the believers.

78.sahih_international: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
78.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord will judge between them of His wisdom, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
78.yusuf_ali: Verily thy Lord will decide between them by His Decree: and He is Exalted in Might, All-Knowing.
78.shakir: Surely your Lord will judge between them by his judgment, and He is the Mighty, the knowing.
78.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord will judge among them according to His own decree. He is Majestic and All-Knowing.
78.mohsin_khan: Verily, your Lord will decide between them (various sects) by His Judgement. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
78.arberry: Surely thy Lord will decide between them by His Judgment; He is the All-mighty, the All-knowing.

79.sahih_international: So rely upon Allah; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.
79.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) put thy trust in Allah, for thou (standest) on the plain Truth.
79.yusuf_ali: So put thy trust in Allah: for thou art on (the path of) manifest Truth.
79.shakir: Therefore rely on Allah; surely you are on the clear truth.
79.muhammad_sarwar: Trust in God for you follow the manifest truth.
79.mohsin_khan: So put your trust in Allah; surely, you (O Muhammad SAW) are on manifest truth.
79.arberry: So put thy trust in God; thou art upon the manifest truth.

80.sahih_international: Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.
80.pickthall: Lo! thou canst not make the dead to hear, nor canst thou make the deaf to hear the call when they have turned to flee;
80.yusuf_ali: Truly thou canst not cause the dead to listen, nor canst thou cause the deaf to hear the call, (especially) when they turn back in retreat.
80.shakir: Surely you do not make the dead to hear, and you do not make the deaf to hear the call when they go back retreating.
80.muhammad_sarwar: You cannot make the dead listen and the deaf are unable to hear calls. Thus, they turn back on their heels.
80.mohsin_khan: Verily, you cannot make the dead to hear (i.e. benefit them and similarly the disbelievers), nor can you make the deaf to hear the call, when they flee, turning their backs.
80.arberry: Thou shalt not make the dead to hear, neither shalt thou make the deaf to hear the call when they turn about, retreating.

81.sahih_international: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [submitting to Allah].
81.pickthall: Nor canst thou lead the blind out of their error. Thou canst make none to hear, save those who believe Our revelations and who have surrendered.
81.yusuf_ali: Nor canst thou be a guide to the blind, (to prevent them) from straying: only those wilt thou get to listen who believe in Our Signs, and they will bow in Islam.
81.shakir: Nor can you be a guide to the blind out of their error; you cannot make to bear (any one) except those who believe in Our communications, so they submit.
81.muhammad_sarwar: You cannot guide the straying blind ones. You can only make hear those who believe in Our revelations submissively.
81.mohsin_khan: Nor can you lead the blind out of their error, you can only make to hear those who believe in Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), and who have submitted (themselves to Allah in Islam as Muslims).
81.arberry: Thou shalt not guide the blind out of their error neither shalt thou make any to hear, save such as believe in Our signs, and so surrender.

82.sahih_international: And when the word befalls them, We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of Our verses, not certain [in faith].
82.pickthall: And when the word is fulfilled concerning them, We shall bring forth a beast of the earth to speak unto them because mankind had not faith in Our revelations.
82.yusuf_ali: And when the Word is fulfilled against them (the unjust), we shall produce from the earth a beast to (face) them: He will speak to them, for that mankind did not believe with assurance in Our Signs.
82.shakir: And when the word shall come to pass against them, We shall bring forth for them a creature from the earth that shall wound them, because people did not believe in Our communications.
82.muhammad_sarwar: When the word about them comes true We shall make a creature appear to them on earth who will tell them that people had no faith in Our revelations.
82.mohsin_khan: And when the Word (of torment) is fulfilled against them, We shall bring out from the earth a beast to them, which will speak to them because mankind believed not with certainty in Our Ayat (Verses of the Quran and Prophet Muhammad SAW).
82.arberry: When the Word falls on them, We shall bring forth for them out of the earth a beast that shall speak unto them: 'Mankind had no faith in Our signs.'

83.sahih_international: And [warn of] the Day when We will gather from every nation a company of those who deny Our signs, and they will be [driven] in rows
83.pickthall: And (remind them of) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a host of those who denied Our revelations, and they will be set in array;
83.yusuf_ali: One day We shall gather together from every people a troop of those who reject our Signs, and they shall be kept in ranks,-
83.shakir: And on the day when We will gather from every nation a party from among those who rejected Our communications, then they shall be formed into groups.
83.muhammad_sarwar: On the day when We resurrect from every nation a group from among those who had rejected Our revelations, they will be kept confined in ranks.
83.mohsin_khan: And (remember) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a troop of those who denied Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), and (then) they (all) shall be gathered (and driven to the place of reckoning),
83.arberry: Upon the day when We shall muster out of every nation a troop of those that cried lies to Our signs, duly disposed,

84.sahih_international: Until, when they arrive [at the place of Judgement], He will say, "Did you deny My signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing?"
84.pickthall: Till, when they come (before their Lord), He will say: Did ye deny My revelations when ye could not compass them in knowledge, or what was it that ye did?
84.yusuf_ali: Until, when they come (before the Judgment-seat), (Allah) will say: "Did ye reject My Signs, though ye comprehended them not in knowledge, or what was it ye did?"
84.shakir: Until when they come, He will say: Did you reject My communications while you had no comprehensive knowledge of them? Or what was it that you did?
84.muhammad_sarwar: When they will be brought into the presence of God, He will ask them, "Did you reject My revelations without fully understanding them. What did you know about them if you had any knowledge at all?
84.mohsin_khan: Till, when they come (before their Lord at the place of reckoning), He will say: "Did you deny My Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) when you comprehended them not in knowledge, or what (else) was it that you used to do?"
84.arberry: till, when they are come, He shall say, 'Did you cry lies to My signs, not comprehending them in knowledge, or what have you been doing?'

85.sahih_international: And the decree will befall them for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.
85.pickthall: And the Word will be fulfilled concerning them because they have done wrong, and they will not speak.
85.yusuf_ali: And the Word will be fulfilled against them, because of their wrong-doing, and they will be unable to speak (in plea).
85.shakir: And the word shall come to pass against them because they were unjust, so they shall not speak.
85.muhammad_sarwar: They will become subject to punishment because of their injustice. Thus, they will not speak.
85.mohsin_khan: And the Word (of torment) will be fulfilled against them, because they have done wrong, and they will be unable to speak (in order to defend themselves).
85.arberry: And the Word shall fall upon them because of the evil they committed, while they speak naught.

86.sahih_international: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
86.pickthall: Have they not seen how We have appointed the night that they may rest therein, and the day sight-giving? Lo! therein verily are portents for a people who believe.
86.yusuf_ali: See they not that We have made the Night for them to rest in and the Day to give them light? Verily in this are Signs for any people that believe!
86.shakir: Do they not consider that We have made the night that. they may rest therein, and the day to give light? Most surely there are signs in this for a people who believe.
86.muhammad_sarwar: Have they not seen that We have created the night for them to rest and the day for them to see. In this there is evidence for the believing people.
86.mohsin_khan: See they not that We have made the night for them to rest therein, and the day sight-giving? Verily, in this are Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) for the people who believe.
86.arberry: Have they not seen how We made the night for them, to repose in it, and the day, to see? Surely in that is a sign for a people who are believers.

87.sahih_international: And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allah wills. And all will come to Him humbled.
87.pickthall: And (remind them of) the Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and all who are in the heavens and the earth will start in fear, save him whom Allah willeth. And all come unto Him, humbled.
87.yusuf_ali: And the Day that the Trumpet will be sounded - then will be smitten with terror those who are in the heavens, and those who are on earth, except such as Allah will please (to exempt): and all shall come to His (Presence) as beings conscious of their lowliness.
87.shakir: And on the day when the trumpet shall be blown, then those who are in the heavens and those who are in the earth shall be terrified except such as Allah please, and all shall come to him abased.
87.muhammad_sarwar: Everyone in the heavens and earth will be terrified on the day when the trumpet will be sounded except those whom God will save. Everyone will humbly come into the presence of God.
87.mohsin_khan: And (remember) the Day on which the Trumpet will be blown and all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth, will be terrified except him whom Allah will (exempt). And all shall come to Him humbled.
87.arberry: On the day the Trumpet is blown, and terrified is whosoever is in the heavens and earth, excepting whom God wills, and every one shall come to Him, all utterly abject;

88.sahih_international: And you see the mountains, thinking them rigid, while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [It is] the work of Allah, who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Acquainted with that which you do.
88.pickthall: And thou seest the hills thou deemest solid flying with the flight of clouds: the doing of Allah Who perfecteth all things. Lo! He is Informed of what ye do.
88.yusuf_ali: Thou seest the mountains and thinkest them firmly fixed: but they shall pass away as the clouds pass away: (such is) the artistry of Allah, who disposes of all things in perfect order: for he is well acquainted with all that ye do.
88.shakir: And you see the mountains, you think them to be solid, and they shall pass away as the passing away of the cloud-- the handiwork of Allah Who has made every thing thoroughly; surely He is Aware of what you do.
88.muhammad_sarwar: You think the mountains are solid. In fact, they move like clouds. It is God's technique which has established everything perfectly. He is well Aware of what you do.
88.mohsin_khan: And you will see the mountains and think them solid, but they shall pass away as the passing away of the clouds. The Work of Allah, Who perfected all things, verily! He is Well-Acquainted with what you do.
88.arberry: and thou shalt see the mountains, that thou supposest fixed, passing by like clouds -- God's handiwork, who has created everything very well. He is aware of the things you do.

89.sahih_international: Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.
89.pickthall: Whoso bringeth a good deed will have better than its worth; and such are safe from fear that Day.
89.yusuf_ali: If any do good, good will (accrue) to them therefrom; and they will be secure from terror that Day.
89.shakir: Whoever brings good, he shall have better than it; and they shall be secure from terror on the day.
89.muhammad_sarwar: Whoever does a good deed will receive a better reward than what he has done. He will be secure from the terror of the Day of Judgment.
89.mohsin_khan: Whoever brings a good deed (i.e. Belief in the Oneness of Allah along with every deed of righteousness), will have better than its worth, and they will be safe from the terror on that Day.
89.arberry: Whosoever comes with a good deed, he shall have better than it; and they shall be secure from terror that day.

90.sahih_international: And whoever comes with an evil deed - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?"
90.pickthall: And whoso bringeth an ill-deed, such will be flung down on their faces in the Fire. Are ye rewarded aught save what ye did?
90.yusuf_ali: And if any do evil, their faces will be thrown headlong into the Fire: "Do ye receive a reward other than that which ye have earned by your deeds?"
90.shakir: And whoever brings evil, these shall be thrown down on their faces into the fire; shall you be rewarded (for) aught except what you did?
90.muhammad_sarwar: Those who commit evil will be thrown headlong into hell fire. (It will be said to them) can you expect any recompense other than what you deserve for your deeds?
90.mohsin_khan: And whoever brings an evil (deed) (i.e. Shirk polytheism, disbelief in the Oneness of Allah and every evil sinful deed), they will be cast down (prone) on their faces in the Fire. (And it will be said to them) "Are you being recompensed anything except what you used to do?"
90.arberry: And whosoever comes with an evil deed, their faces shall be thrust into the Fire: 'Are you recompensed but for what you did?'

91.sahih_international: [Say, O Muhammad], "I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city, who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims [those who submit to Allah]
91.pickthall: (Say): I (Muhammad) am commanded only to serve the Lord of this land which He hath hallowed, and unto Whom all things belong. And I am commanded to be of those who surrender (unto Him),
91.yusuf_ali: For me, I have been commanded to serve the Lord of this city, Him Who has sanctified it and to Whom (belong) all things: and I am commanded to be of those who bow in Islam to Allah's Will,-
91.shakir: I am commanded only that I should serve the Lord of this city, Who has made it sacred, and His are all things; and I am commanded that I should be of these who submit;
91.muhammad_sarwar: I am commanded to worship the Lord of this town which He has made sacred. To Him belong all things. I am commanded to be a Muslim
91.mohsin_khan: I (Muhammad SAW) have been commanded only to worship the Lord of this city (Makkah), Him Who has sanctified it and His is everything. And I am commanded to be from among the Muslims (those who submit to Allah in Islam).
91.arberry: I have only been commanded to serve the Lord of this territory which He has made sacred; to Him belongs everything. And I have been commanded to be of those that surrender,

92.sahih_international: And to recite the Qur'an." And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only [one] of the warners."
92.pickthall: And to recite the Qur'an. And whoso goeth right, goeth right only for (the good of) his own soul; and as for him who goeth astray - (Unto him) say: Lo! I am only a warner.
92.yusuf_ali: And to rehearse the Qur'an: and if any accept guidance, they do it for the good of their own souls, and if any stray, say: "I am only a Warner".
92.shakir: And that I should recite the Quran. Therefore whoever goes aright, he goes aright for his own soul, and whoever goes ' astray, then say: I am only one of the warners.
92.muhammad_sarwar: and recite the Quran. Whoever seeks guidance will find it for his own soul. Say to whoever goes astray, "I am only a warner".
92.mohsin_khan: And to recite the Quran, so whosoever receives guidance, receives it for the good of his ownself, and whosoever goes astray, say (to him): "I am only one of the warners."
92.arberry: and to recite the Koran. So whosoever is guided, is only guided to his own gain; and whosoever goes astray, say: 'I am naught but a warner.

93.sahih_international: And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allah. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."
93.pickthall: And say: Praise be to Allah Who will show you His portents so that ye shall know them. And thy Lord is not unaware of what ye (mortals) do.
93.yusuf_ali: And say: "Praise be to Allah, Who will soon show you His Signs, so that ye shall know them"; and thy Lord is not unmindful of all that ye do.
93.shakir: And say: Praise be to Allah, He will show you His signs so that you shall recognize them; nor is your Lord heedless of what you do.
93.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "It is only He who deserves all praise. He will soon show you His signs and you will recognize them. Your Lord is not unaware of what you do.
93.mohsin_khan: And say [(O Muhammad SAW) to these polytheists and pagans etc.]: "All the praises and thanks be to Allah. He will show you His Ayat (signs, in yourselves, and in the universe or punishments, etc.), and you shall recognise them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."
93.arberry: And say: 'Praise belongs to God. He shall show you His signs and you will recognise them. Thy Lord is not heedless of the things you do.'
